description: Status of a cross-chain transfer by its source transaction hash, for transfers made through LI.FI and the bridges it routes (Stargate, Across, CCTP, Hop, Polymer and more): DONE, PENDING, FAILED or NOT_FOUND, the sub-status and its message, sending and receiving transaction hashes, chains, tokens, amounts and explorer links. Use to check whether funds arrived before an agent continues. Example: txHash=0x8f9e2c2a7a6e0f5b1c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef0123. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

fromChain.description: Optional source chain name or id, to speed up the lookup

txHash.description: Hash of the transaction on the source chain

name: bridge_status
title: Bridge status, cross-chain transfer tracker
